inputs.adapter: tools/science_funnel/adapters_muscle.py (the admitted-adapter read; row laws enforced at 2%)

laws.volume: V = m / rho, rho = 1060 kg/m^3 = 1.06e-6 kg/mm^3 (the dataset's own closure constant; Mendez & Keys 1960)
laws.path: muscle_path_geometry neutral pose, m -> mm x1000
laws.capsule: pi r^2 L - (2/3) pi r^3 = V, bisection 1e-12 on [0, L/2]; sphere bound pi L^3/6; prolate-spheroid fallback recorded per muscle
laws.mass: kernel law area x thickness x density with thickness := V / A_mesh (the derived equivalent shell)
laws.mesh: 48 circumferential x 52 meridian parallels (polar profile) -- discretization only; the enclosed-volume check (0.5%) gates it per muscle
laws.attachment: the landmark book (no bonds: the adult bone layer does not exist as matter; successor)
